hook: The $46.99 organizer that makes the other four fixes stick

scenes.visual_prompt: Opening a jammed under-sink cabinet stuffed with cleaning supplies around pipes
scenes.on_screen_text: The most wasted storage zone in a kitchen
scenes.voiceover: Under the sink is consistently the most wasted storage zone in a kitchen, because of pipe obstructions.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand trying to shove a new tray into an already-full cabinet that won't close
scenes.on_screen_text: A full cabinet is why organizing projects fail
scenes.voiceover: If the cabinet behind your new organizer is already full, you've just relocated the clutter, not solved it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Installing the PXRACK Expandable Under-Sink Organizer with 2 pull-out drawers around pipe obstructions
scenes.on_screen_text: PXRACK Expandable Under-Sink Organizer - $46.99, 4.7 stars, 1,773 ratings
scenes.voiceover: The PXRACK is $46.99, the most expensive item in this comparison, with an expandable frame that adjusts around plumbing.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pulling out the two drawers smoothly to show newly organized space
scenes.on_screen_text: Two pull-out drawers, built around the pipes
scenes.voiceover: Two pull-out drawers, and it expands to fit the space the pipes don't use.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of newly freed cabinet space elsewhere in the kitchen
scenes.on_screen_text: This is what makes the $17.99 and $19.99 fixes stick
scenes.voiceover: This is the piece that makes the cheaper fixes actually stick instead of filling back up.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final shot of all five products laid out together with a total price overlay
scenes.voiceover: All five products together ran me $149.92. The counter's been clear for three weeks.

caption: This is the one people skip, and it's why every other counter fix stops working within a month. The PXRACK Expandable Under-Sink Organizer is $46.99 - the priciest thing in a 5-product comparison I ran, but the one reviewers credit with reclaiming the most usable cabinet space.
